item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows line AB, point P not on AB, and three trial lines through P labelled m, n, and k.

Which claim correctly identifies a line through P parallel to AB?

options.A: Line m, because it keeps the same direction as AB and does not meet AB.
options.B: Any line through the given point P is already parallel to AB.
options.C: Point P is what produces line AB, so drawing line k through P creates AB first.
options.D: Line n, because it meets AB at right angles and perpendicular marks settle parallelism.
